scripts.script:
pcall(function()

	local set = setthreadidentity or set_thread_identity or setthreadcontext or set_identity

	if set then pcall(set, 8) pcall(set, 7) end

end)

local RGB = Color3.fromRGB

local CREDIT_LINK = "https://discord.gg/7Pfw9GWnub"
local CREDIT_TEXT = "Open sourced and removed key system by " .. CREDIT_LINK

local function copyLink()
	local ok = false
	pcall(function() if type(setclipboard) == "function" then setclipboard(CREDIT_LINK) ok = true end end)
	pcall(function()
		local s = game:GetService("StarterGui")
		if s and s.SetClipboard then s:SetClipboard(CREDIT_LINK) ok = true end
	end)
	return ok
end

local function creditWait()
	local player = game:GetService("Players")
	local tween = game:GetService("TweenService")
	local uis = game:GetService("UserInputService")

	local host
	pcall(function() if type(gethui) == "function" then host = gethui() end end)
	if type(host) ~= "Instance" then host = game:GetService("CoreGui"):FindFirstChild("RobloxGui") end
	if not host then host = player.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end

	local done = false

	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "LiquidHubCredit" gui.DisplayOrder = 999999 gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false gui.Parent = host

	local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
	bg.Name = "Backdrop" bg.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) bg.BackgroundColor3 = RGB(3, 5, 10)
	bg.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2 bg.BorderSizePixel = 0 bg.Active = true bg.Parent = gui

	local card = Instance.new("TextButton")
	card.Name = "Card" card.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5) card.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	card.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(460, 240) card.BackgroundColor3 = RGB(10, 14, 22)
	card.BorderSizePixel = 0 card.AutoButtonColor = false card.Text = "" card.TextTransparency = 1
	card.Active = true card.Parent = bg

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner") corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10) corner.Parent = card
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke") stroke.Color = RGB(28, 42, 62) stroke.Thickness = 1 stroke.Parent = card

	local function label(str, ypos, h, sz, col, align)
		local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		l.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, h) l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, ypos)
		l.BackgroundTransparency = 1 l.Font = Enum.Font.Code l.TextSize = sz
		l.Text = str l.TextColor3 = col l.TextXAlignment = align or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		l.Active = false l.Parent = card
		return l
	end

	label("LIQUID HUB", 20, 14, 11, RGB(88, 102, 122))
	label("OPEN SOURCE", 20, 14, 11, RGB(18, 168, 255), Enum.TextXAlignment.Right)

	local rule = Instance.new("Frame")
	rule.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 1) rule.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 44)
	rule.BackgroundColor3 = RGB(28, 42, 62) rule.BorderSizePixel = 0 rule.Parent = card

	label("Key system removed", 60, 30, 24, RGB(226, 236, 246))
	local sub = label(CREDIT_TEXT, 96, 58, 13, RGB(122, 138, 160))
	sub.TextWrapped = true sub.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top

	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Name = "Copy" btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 40) btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 162)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = RGB(18, 168, 255) btn.BorderSizePixel = 0 btn.AutoButtonColor = false
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.Code btn.TextSize = 14 btn.Text = "copy link" btn.TextColor3 = RGB(4, 11, 24)
	btn.Active = true btn.Parent = card
	local bc = Instance.new("UICorner") bc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) bc.Parent = btn

	label("or press enter", 208, 14, 11, RGB(70, 82, 100), Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)

	local function paint(target, col)
		tween:Create(target, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = col}):Play()
	end

	btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() paint(btn, RGB(64, 198, 255)) end)
	btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() paint(btn, RGB(18, 168, 255)) end)
	card.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {Color = RGB(54, 100, 146)}):Play() end)
	card.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {Color = RGB(28, 42, 62)}):Play() end)

	local conn
	local function accept()
		if done then return end
		if not copyLink() then
			btn.Text = "copy failed - press enter to retry"
			paint(btn, RGB(196, 58, 78))
			return
		end
		done = true
		btn.Text = "copied - loading"
		if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
	end

	conn = uis.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, focused)
		if done or focused then return end
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Return or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space then accept() end
	end)

	card.MouseButton1Click:Connect(accept)
	card.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then accept() end
	end)
	btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(accept)

	while not done do task.wait(0.1) end

	local fade = TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	tween:Create(bg, fade, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
	tween:Create(card, fade, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
	tween:Create(stroke, fade, {Transparency = 1}):Play()
	for _, d in ipairs(card:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") then
			tween:Create(d, fade, {TextTransparency = 1, BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
		elseif d:IsA("Frame") then
			tween:Create(d, fade, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
		end
	end

	task.wait(0.45)
	pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end)
end

		status.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)

		status.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 22)
		status.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		status.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
		status.TextSize = 13
		status.Text = "Loading interface..."
		status.TextColor3 = BRAND.Cyan
		status.Parent = backdrop

		sheen.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		sheen.Position = UDim2.fromScale(-0.3, 0.42)
		sheen.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 180)
		sheen.BackgroundTransparency = 0.9
		sheen.BorderSizePixel = 0
		sheen.Rotation = 20
		sheen.Parent = backdrop
		Instance.new("UICorner", sheen).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

		TweenService:Create(sheen, TweenInfo.new(1.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(1.3, 0.42),
		}):Play()

		TweenService:Create(glow, TweenInfo.new(2.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true), {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(470, 470),

		Splash = { gui = gui, status = status }
	end
end

local function splashStatus(text)
	if Splash and Splash.status then
		pcall(function() Splash.status.Text = text end)
	end
end

local function splashClose()
	if not Splash then return end
	local gui = Splash.gui
	local ok = pcall(function()
		if not gui or not gui.Parent then return end
		local backdrop = gui:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Frame")
		if backdrop then
			TweenService:Create(backdrop, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			}):Play()
		end
		task.wait(0.32)
		gui:Destroy()
	end)
	if not ok then pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end) end
	Splash = nil
end

pcall(function()
	local rg = game:GetService("CoreGui"):FindFirstChild("RobloxGui")
	if not rg then return end
	for _, sg in ipairs(rg:GetChildren()) do
		if sg:IsA("ScreenGui") then
			if sg.Name == "Obsidian" or sg.Name == "NebulaUI" or sg.Name == "KeySystem" then
				sg:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end
end)

pcall(function()
	local pg = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
	if not pg then return end
	for _, sg in ipairs(pg:GetChildren()) do
		if sg:IsA("ScreenGui") and (sg.Name == "LiquidSplash" or sg.Name == "KeySystem") then
			sg:Destroy()
		end

end)

local Repo = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tyanxblack2-max/asdfasd/refs/heads/main/ui-libs/obsidian-ultra/"

local LIB_SOURCES = {
	Repo .. "Library.lua",
	"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/tyanxblack2-max/asdfasd@main/ui-libs/obsidian-ultra/Library.lua",
}

splashStatus("Loading interface...")

local Library = nil

for _, url in ipairs(LIB_SOURCES) do
	local ok, res = pcall(function()
		return game:HttpGet(url .. "?nocache=" .. tostring(os.time()))
	end)
	if ok and type(res) == "string" and #res > 2000 then
		local chunk, cerr = (loadstring or load)(res)
		if chunk then
			local okLib, lib = pcall(chunk)
			if okLib and type(lib) == "table" then
				Library = lib
				break
			end
		else
			warn("[Liquid Hub] Compile error: " .. tostring(cerr))
		end
	end
end

if not Library or type(Library) ~= "table" then
	warn("[Liquid Hub] Failed to load ObsidianUltra from all sources")
	splashClose()
	return
end

local SaveManager
pcall(function()
	SaveManager = loadstring(game:HttpGet(Repo .. "addons/SaveManager.lua"))()
end)

local GAME_NAME = "Unknown Game"
do
	local pid = game.PlaceId
	local ok, name = pcall(function()
		local Http = game:GetService("HttpService")
		local res = game:HttpGet("https://apis.roblox.com/universes/v1/places/" .. pid .. "/universe")
		local universeId = Http:JSONDecode(res).universeId
		local res2 = game:HttpGet("https://games.roblox.com/v1/games?universeIds=" .. universeId)
		return Http:JSONDecode(res2).data[1].name
	end)
	if ok and type(name) == "string" and #name > 0 then
		GAME_NAME = name
	else
		pcall(function()
			for _, attr in ipairs({ "GameName", "PlaceName", "DisplayName" }) do
				local v = ReplicatedStorage:GetAttribute(attr)
				if type(v) == "string" and #v > 0 then
					GAME_NAME = v
					break
				end
			end
		end)
		if GAME_NAME == "Unknown Game" and pid ~= 0 then
			GAME_NAME = "Place " .. pid
		end
	end
end

	Library.Scheme.BackgroundColor = Color3.fromHex("02060F")
	Library.Scheme.MainColor       = Color3.fromHex("071229")
	Library.Scheme.OutlineColor    = Color3.fromHex("1D4E7A")

pcall(function()

	if Library.SetFont then Library:SetFont(Enum.Font.Code) end
	if Library.UpdateColorsUsingRegistry then Library:UpdateColorsUsingRegistry() end

local Tabs = {
	Main      = Window:AddTab({ Name = "Main", Icon = ICON.Drops, Description = "Session overview" }),
	Farming   = Window:AddTab({ Name = "Farming", Icon = ICON.Bolt, Description = "Training, eggs, selling and rewards" }),

splashStatus("Waiting for game data...")

local function getCharacter() return LocalPlayer.Character end

local function getHumanoid()
	local char = getCharacter()
	return char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local function getRoot()
	local char = getCharacter()
	return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 15)

if not Remotes then
	Library:Notify({ Title = BRAND.Name, Description = "Remotes folder not found. Join the game first.", Time = 6, Type = "Error" })
	splashClose()
	return
end

local function waitRemote(name, parent)
	local success, instance = pcall(function()
		return (parent or Remotes):WaitForChild(name, 10)
	end)
	if success then return instance end
	return nil
end

local PlaceEggRequest      = waitRemote("PlaceEggRequest")
local DropEggRequest       = waitRemote("DropEggRequest")
local SellRemote           = waitRemote("Sell")
local CoilsRemote          = waitRemote("Coils")
local TrailsRemote         = waitRemote("Trails")
local SquatTrainingRequest = waitRemote("SquatTrainingRequest")
local StopSquattingRequest = waitRemote("StopSquattingRequest")
local SquatBonusRequest    = waitRemote("SquatBonusRequest")
local OfflineRewardsRemote = waitRemote("OfflineRewards")
local IndexRewardRemote    = waitRemote("ClaimAnimalIndexReward")

local REMOTE_COUNT = 0
for _, r in ipairs({
	PlaceEggRequest, DropEggRequest, SellRemote, CoilsRemote, TrailsRemote,
	SquatTrainingRequest, StopSquattingRequest, SquatBonusRequest,
	OfflineRewardsRemote, IndexRewardRemote,
}) do
	if r then REMOTE_COUNT += 1 end
end

if REMOTE_COUNT < 10 then
	warn(string.format(
		"[Liquid Hub] only %d/10 remotes resolved - features depending on the missing ones will do nothing",
		REMOTE_COUNT))
end

local Settings = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Settings")

local function requireSetting(name)
	local module = Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not module then return nil end
	local success, result = pcall(require, module)
	if success then return result end
	return nil
end

local Rarities         = requireSetting("Rarities")
local SpeedUpgrades    = requireSetting("SpeedUpgrades")
local TrailSettings    = requireSetting("Trails")
local BarbellUpgrades  = requireSetting("BarbellUpgrades")
local RecommendedJumps = requireSetting("RecommendedJumps")

local ZoneJumpRequirements = { Meadow = 25 }

if RecommendedJumps and type(RecommendedJumps.List) == "table" then
	for key, value in pairs(RecommendedJumps.List) do
		local zone = string.gsub(tostring(key), "%d+$", "")
		local jump = tonumber(value)
		if jump and (ZoneJumpRequirements[zone] == nil or jump < ZoneJumpRequirements[zone]) then
			ZoneJumpRequirements[zone] = jump
		end
	end
end

local function teleportTo(position)
	local root = getRoot()
	if root and position then
		root.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
		return true
	end
	return false
end

local function holderPosition(holder)
	if not holder then return nil end
	if holder:IsA("BasePart") then return holder.Position end
	if holder:IsA("Attachment") then return holder.WorldPosition end
	return nil
end

local function getPlot()
	local plot = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Plot")
	return plot and plot.Value or nil
end

local function getSquatDetector()
	local plot  = getPlot()
	local zone  = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("SquatZone")
	local floor = zone and zone:FindFirstChild("Floor")
	return floor and floor:FindFirstChild("Detector") or nil
end

local function getPlacementDetector()
	local plot = getPlot()
	return plot and plot:FindFirstChild("Detector", true) or nil
end

local function getCash()
	local leaderstats = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local cash = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Cash")
	local value = cash and cash:FindFirstChild("V")
	return value and tonumber(value.Value) or 0
end

local function getLevel()
	local leaderstats = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local level = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Level")
	local value = level and level:FindFirstChild("V")
	return value and tonumber(value.Value) or 0
end

local function isPetTool(tool)
	return tool:IsA("Tool") and tool:GetAttribute("IsPetInventoryTool") == true
end

local function isEggTool(tool)
	return tool:IsA("Tool") and tool:GetAttribute("IsEggTool") == true
end

local function forEachContainer(fn)
	local character = getCharacter()
	if LocalPlayer.Backpack then fn(LocalPlayer.Backpack) end
	if character then fn(character) end
end

local function findTool(predicate)
	local found
	forEachContainer(function(container)
		if found then return end
		for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Tool") and predicate(child) then
				found = child
				return
			end
		end
	end)
	return found
end

local function countEggTools()
	local count = 0
	forEachContainer(function(container)
		for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
			if isEggTool(child) then count += 1 end
		end
	end)
	return count
end

local function countPlacedEggs()
	local plot   = getPlot()
	local placed = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("PlacedEggs")
	return placed and #placed:GetChildren() or 0
end

local function countReadyEggs()
	local plot   = getPlot()
	local placed = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("PlacedEggs")
	if not placed then return 0 end
	local ready = 0
	for _, egg in ipairs(placed:GetChildren()) do
		if egg:GetAttribute("HatchReady") == true then ready += 1 end
	end

				if not seen[name] then

				end
			end
		end
	end)
	table.sort(names)
	return names
end

local function abbreviate(value)
	value = tonumber(value) or 0
	local units = { "", "K", "M", "B", "T", "Qa", "Qi" }
	local index = 1
	while value >= 1000 and index < #units do
		value /= 1000
		index += 1
	end
	if index == 1 then return tostring(math.floor(value)) end
	return string.format("%.2f%s", value, units[index])
end

local function formatClock(seconds)
	seconds = math.max(math.floor(seconds), 0)
	local hours   = math.floor(seconds / 3600)
	local minutes = math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60)
	local secs    = seconds % 60
	return string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d", hours, minutes, secs)
end

local function packSet(sel)
	if type(sel) ~= "table" then return "" end
	local names = {}
	for k, v in pairs(sel) do
		if type(k) == "string" then names[#names + 1] = k end
		if type(v) == "string" then names[#names + 1] = v end
	end
	table.sort(names)
	return table.concat(names, ",")
end

local function unpackSet(str)
	local set = {}
	if type(str) == "string" and str ~= "" then
		for name in string.gmatch(str, "[^,]+") do
			set[name] = true
		end
	end
	return set
end

local function asList(packed)
	local list = {}
	if type(packed) == "string" and packed ~= "" then
		for name in string.gmatch(packed, "[^,]+") do
			list[#list + 1] = name
		end
	end
	return list
end

local function selHas(sel, value)
	if type(sel) ~= "table" then return true end
	local count, hit = 0, false
	for k, v in pairs(sel) do
		count += 1
		if v == true and k == value then hit = true end
		if v == value then hit = true end
	end
	if count == 0 then return true end
	return hit
end

local function startFly()
	local char = getCharacter()
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = getHumanoid()
	if not hrp or not hum then return end

	flyOn = true
	setFlag("FlyOn", true)
	pcall(function() hum.PlatformStand = true end)

	flyBG = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	flyBG.P = 9e4
	flyBG.maxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
	flyBG.cframe = hrp.CFrame
	flyBG.Parent = hrp

	flyBV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	flyBV.velocity = Vector3.zero
	flyBV.maxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
	flyBV.Parent = hrp

	setNoclip(true)

	flyConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not flyOn or not isCurrentGen() then stopFly() return end
		local char2 = getCharacter()
		local hrp2 = char2 and char2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not hrp2 or not flyBV or not flyBG or not cam then return end

		local move = Vector3.zero
		if flyKeys.W then move += cam.CFrame.LookVector end
		if flyKeys.S then move -= cam.CFrame.LookVector end
		if flyKeys.A then move -= cam.CFrame.RightVector end
		if flyKeys.D then move += cam.CFrame.RightVector end
		if flyKeys.Space then move += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
		if flyKeys.Ctrl then move -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
		if move.Magnitude > 0 then move = move.Unit * flySpeed end

		flyBV.velocity = move
		flyBG.cframe = cam.CFrame
	end)
end

local function zoneReachable(zone)
	local required = ZoneJumpRequirements[zone]
	if required == nil then return true end
	local jp = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("JumpPower")
	jp = jp and tonumber(jp.Value) or 0
	return jp >= required
end

local function findEggPrompt(mode)
	local map    = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	local stages = map and map:FindFirstChild("Stages")
	if not stages then return nil, nil end

	local root = getRoot()
	local origin = root and root.Position or Vector3.zero
	local zoneFilter   = unpackSet(getFlag("StealZones"))
	local rarityFilter = unpackSet(getFlag("StealRarities"))

	local bestPrompt, bestScore, bestPosition

	for _, stage in ipairs(stages:GetChildren()) do
		local spawned = stage:FindFirstChild("SpawnedEggs")
		if spawned and selHas(zoneFilter, stage.Name) then
			for _, egg in ipairs(spawned:GetChildren()) do
				local rarity = egg:GetAttribute("Rarity")
				if selHas(rarityFilter, rarity) then
					local prompt = egg:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
					if prompt and prompt.Enabled then
						local worldPosition = holderPosition(prompt.Parent)
						if worldPosition then
							local distance = (worldPosition - origin).Magnitude
							local rarityIndex = 0
							if Rarities and Rarities.GetIndex then
								rarityIndex = Rarities.GetIndex(rarity) or 0
							end
							local score
							if mode == "Nearest Egg" then
								score = -distance
							else

								if mode == "Best Egg" and not zoneReachable(stage.Name) then continue end
								score = rarityIndex * 1000000 - distance * 0.001
							end
							if not bestScore or score > bestScore then
								bestPrompt, bestScore, bestPosition = prompt, score, worldPosition
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return bestPrompt, bestPosition
end

local function doCarryRecovery()
	if not Toggles.AutoSteal.Value and not Toggles.AutoPlace.Value then
		CarryWatchSince = nil
		return
	end

	local carried = (tonumber(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("CarriedEggCount")) or 0) > 0
	local tool = findTool(isEggTool)

	if carried and not tool then
		local base = getPlacementDetector()
		local root = getRoot()
		if base and root and (root.Position - base.Position).Magnitude > 40 then
			teleportTo(base.Position)
			task.wait(0.4)
		end
		if not CarryWatchSince then
			CarryWatchSince = os.clock()
		elseif os.clock() - CarryWatchSince > 30 and DropEggRequest then
			DropEggRequest:FireServer()
			CarryWatchSince = os.clock()
			task.wait(0.5)
		end
	else
		CarryWatchSince = nil
	end
end

local function doAutoTrain()
	if not Toggles.AutoTrain.Value then return end

	if Toggles.AutoHatch.Value and countReadyEggs() > 0 then
		if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IsSquatting") == true and StopSquattingRequest then
			StopSquattingRequest:FireServer()
		end
		return
	end

	if Toggles.AutoSteal.Value and (tonumber(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("CarriedEggCount")) or 0) > 0 then
		return
	end

	local detector = getSquatDetector()
	local root = getRoot()
	if not detector or not root then return end

	if (root.Position - detector.Position).Magnitude > 10 then
		teleportTo(detector.Position)
		task.wait(0.3)
	end

	if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IsSquatting") ~= true and SquatTrainingRequest then
		SquatTrainingRequest:FireServer(detector)

local function doAutoPlace()
	if not Toggles.AutoPlace.Value or not PlaceEggRequest then return end
	if os.clock() < NextPlaceAttempt then return end

	local list = {}
	forEachContainer(function(container)
		for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
			if isEggTool(child) then table.insert(list, child) end
		end
	end)
	if #list == 0 then return end

	PlaceRotation += 1
	local carrying = list[(PlaceRotation % #list) + 1]
	local humanoid = getHumanoid()
	local detector = getPlacementDetector()
	if not humanoid or not detector then return end

	NextPlaceAttempt = os.clock() + 2
	pcall(function() humanoid:EquipTool(carrying) end)
	task.wait(0.2)

	PlaceEggRequest:FireServer(carrying:GetAttribute("EggId"), detector.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
	task.wait(0.35)

	if not carrying.Parent then
		local delay = tonumber(Options.StealDelay and Options.StealDelay.Value) or 5
		NextStealAt = os.clock() + math.max(delay, 0)
	end

	if (tonumber(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("CarriedEggCount")) or 0) > 0 then return end

	if not prompt or not position then return end

	if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IsSquatting") == true and StopSquattingRequest then
		StopSquattingRequest:FireServer()
		local deadline = os.clock() + 1.5
		while LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IsSquatting") == true and os.clock() < deadline do

		end

	teleportTo(position)
	task.wait(0.35)

	task.wait(0.4)

	local base = getPlacementDetector()
	if base then

	for _, egg in ipairs(placed:GetChildren()) do

local function findSellTarget()
	local mode   = Options.SellMode and Options.SellMode.Value
	local chosen = Options.AutoSellPet and Options.AutoSellPet.Value
	local maxCps = tonumber(Options.SellMaxCps and Options.SellMaxCps.Value) or 1000

	local bestTool, bestCps
	forEachContainer(function(container)
		for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
			if isPetTool(child) then
				local name = child:GetAttribute("AnimalName") or child.Name
				local cps  = tonumber(child:GetAttribute("CashPerSecond")) or math.huge
				if mode == "Chosen Pet" then
					if name == chosen and (not bestCps or cps < bestCps) then
						bestTool, bestCps = child, cps
					end
				elseif cps <= maxCps and (not bestCps or cps < bestCps) then
					bestTool, bestCps = child, cps
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	return bestTool
end

	local candidate, candidateCps
	forEachContainer(function(container)
		for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
			if isPetTool(child) then
				local name = child:GetAttribute("AnimalName") or child.Name
				local cps  = tonumber(child:GetAttribute("CashPerSecond")) or math.huge
				if name == targetName and (not candidateCps or cps < candidateCps) then
					candidate, candidateCps = child, cps
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	return candidate
end

local function findDuplicateAnimal()
	local counts, lowest = {}, {}
	forEachContainer(function(container)
		for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
			if isPetTool(child) then
				local name = child:GetAttribute("AnimalName") or child.Name
				local cps  = tonumber(child:GetAttribute("CashPerSecond")) or math.huge
				counts[name] = (counts[name] or 0) + 1
				if not lowest[name] or cps < lowest[name] then lowest[name] = cps end
			end
		end
	end)

	local bestName, bestCps
	for name, count in pairs(counts) do
		if count >= 2 and (not bestCps or lowest[name] < bestCps) then
			bestName, bestCps = name, lowest[name]
		end
	end
	return bestName
end

scripts.features:
The AI behaves like an aggressive, predictive sword fighter.

It constantly searches for the nearest living opponent and follows them as its main target.

Instead of simply moving toward the opponent's current position, it watches how the opponent is moving and estimates their velocity and acceleration. It uses that information to predict where the opponent will be shortly, then moves and aims toward that predicted position.

The AI tries to avoid moving in a completely straight line. It constantly changes its footwork using randomized behaviors such as strafing, circling, moving behind the opponent, moving to the side, moving diagonally, briefly hesitating, spinning, jumping, and suddenly changing direction.

It has preferred attack-positioning behaviors. It often tries to get behind or beside the opponent instead of staying directly in front of them. Its preferred position is randomized, so its movement does not always look identical.

The AI watches the opponent's movement and can react when the opponent suddenly slows down, changes direction, or turns. When this happens, it can temporarily change its movement pattern or reposition to another side.

It also checks the surrounding space using directional sensing. This lets it determine which directions have more room and which directions are obstructed. It combines this information with its desired direction so it does not blindly move toward the opponent when that direction is unsafe or blocked.

For aiming and facing, the AI does more than simply look directly at the opponent. It evaluates several nearby possible directions and recursively compares them for a short distance into the future. It prefers directions that keep the opponent in front of it, maintain useful positioning, have better clearance, and fit its current movement.

Its turning is smoothed rather than instantly snapping toward the target. This makes its aim continuously adjust as the opponent moves.

The AI also intentionally introduces small aim and movement variations. Its facing direction contains controlled random motion, so its aim is not perfectly identical every frame.

Its movement contains momentum-like behavior. When it has been moving in a useful direction for a while, it can accumulate enough momentum in that direction to trigger a stronger side movement or repositioning maneuver.

The AI periodically rerolls some of its movement and aiming parameters. This changes the exact timing, angle, jitter, and footwork pattern, making the behavior less repetitive.

When the opponent gets close enough, the AI activates its weapon and attempts to attack.

Overall, the behavior is:

Observe opponent → track movement → predict future position → evaluate surrounding space → choose a combat direction → reposition around the opponent → adjust aim → attack when close → repeat continuously.

The AI is not actually learning. It does not remember that a certain opponent beat one of its techniques and then permanently change its strategy. Its variety comes mainly from prediction, short-horizon directional evaluation, predefined behaviors, state changes, and weighted randomness.

Its fighting style can therefore be described as:

Aggressive + predictive + evasive + circling + randomized + short-term tactical.

	if not animationObject:IsA("Animation") then

	if not track.Animation then
		return false
	end

	if animationObject.AnimationId == "" then
		return false
	end

	return animationObject.AnimationId == track.Animation.AnimationId

	local character = getCharacter()

	if not character then
		return false
	end

	local animate = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")

	if not animate then
		return false
	end

	-- Roblox default walking animations
	local walkFolder = animate:FindFirstChild("walk")

	if walkFolder then
		for _, object in ipairs(walkFolder:GetDescendants()) do
			if animationObjectMatchesTrack(object, track) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	-- Roblox default running animations
	local runFolder = animate:FindFirstChild("run")

	if runFolder then
		for _, object in ipairs(runFolder:GetDescendants()) do
			if animationObjectMatchesTrack(object, track) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

	local name = string.lower(track.Name or "")

	-- Common names used by custom animation systems.
	if string.find(name, "walk", 1, true) then
		return true
	end

	if string.find(name, "run", 1, true) then
		return true
	end

	-- Check Roblox's Animate script.
	if isDefaultMovementAnimation(track) then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

	local animator = getAnimator()

	if not animator then

	disconnectAnimationListener()

		end)
	end)

	Settings.NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled = true

	stopNonWalkingAnimations()
	connectAnimationListener()
end

local function enableAllAnimations()
	Settings.NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled = false

	disconnectAnimationListener()
end

	if Settings.NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled then

	else

-- ==========================================

local VectorMath = {}

function VectorMath.getDirectionUnit(origin: Vector3, target: Vector3): Vector3
    local delta = target - origin
    if delta.Magnitude < 0.0001 then
        return Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
    end
    return delta.Unit
end

function VectorMath.getAngleDegrees(lookVector: Vector3, targetDirUnit: Vector3): number
    local dot = math.clamp(lookVector:Dot(targetDirUnit), -1, 1)
    return math.deg(math.acos(dot))
end

function VectorMath.isInVectorFOV(origin: Vector3, lookVector: Vector3, targetPos: Vector3, maxAngleDeg: number): (boolean, number)
    local dirUnit = VectorMath.getDirectionUnit(origin, targetPos)
    local angleDeg = VectorMath.getAngleDegrees(lookVector, dirUnit)
    return (angleDeg <= maxAngleDeg), angleDeg
end

local function getNormalizedSide(player: Player): string?
    if not player then return nil end

    local ok, teamObj = pcall(function() return player.Team end)
    if ok and teamObj and teamObj.Name then
        local name = teamObj.Name:lower()
        if name:find("counter") or name == "ct" or name:find("blue") or name:find("guard") or name:find("cop") then
            return "CT"
        end
        if name:find("terror") or name == "t" or name:find("red") or name:find("robber") or name:find("inmate") then
            return "T"
        end
    end

    local okC, teamColor = pcall(function() return player.TeamColor end)
    if okC and teamColor then
        local cName = teamColor.Name:lower()
        if cName:find("blue") or cName:find("navy") or cName:find("cyan") then return "CT" end
        if cName:find("red") or cName:find("orange") or cName:find("yellow") or cName:find("brown") then return "T" end
    end

    local char = player.Character
    if char and char.Parent then
        local pName = char.Parent.Name:lower()
        if pName:find("counter") or pName == "ct" then return "CT" end
        if pName:find("terror") or pName == "t" then return "T" end
    end

    local attr = player:GetAttribute("Team") or player:GetAttribute("Side") or (char and (char:GetAttribute("Team") or char:GetAttribute("Side")))
    if attr ~= nil then
        local s = tostring(attr):lower()
        if s:find("counter") or s == "ct" or s == "2" then return "CT" end
        if s:find("terror") or s == "t" or s == "1" then return "T" end
    end

    local val = (char and (char:FindFirstChild("Team") or char:FindFirstChild("Side"))) or player:FindFirstChild("Team") or player:FindFirstChild("Side")
    if val and val:IsA("ValueBase") then
        local s = tostring(val.Value):lower()
        if s:find("counter") or s == "ct" or s == "2" then return "CT" end
        if s:find("terror") or s == "t" or s == "1" then return "T" end
    end

    local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
    if leaderstats then
        local stat = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Team") or leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Side")
        if stat and stat:IsA("ValueBase") then
            local s = tostring(stat.Value):lower()
            if s:find("counter") or s == "ct" or s == "2" then return "CT" end
            if s:find("terror") or s == "t" or s == "1" then return "T" end
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function isOppositeTeam(myPlayer: Player, targetPlayer: Player): boolean
    if not myPlayer or not targetPlayer then return false end
    if myPlayer == targetPlayer then return false end

    local mySide = getNormalizedSide(myPlayer)
    local targetSide = getNormalizedSide(targetPlayer)

    if mySide and targetSide then
        return (mySide ~= targetSide)
    end

    local ok1, team1 = pcall(function() return myPlayer.Team end)
    local ok2, team2 = pcall(function() return targetPlayer.Team end)
    if ok1 and ok2 and team1 ~= nil and team2 ~= nil then
        return team1 ~= team2
    end

    local okC1, color1 = pcall(function() return myPlayer.TeamColor end)
    local okC2, color2 = pcall(function() return targetPlayer.TeamColor end)
    if okC1 and okC2 and color1 ~= nil and color2 ~= nil then
        return color1 ~= color2
    end

    return true
end

local partChamsCache = {}
local highlightChamsCache = {}

local function isVisibleBodyPart(part)
    if not part:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
    local name = part.Name:lower()
    if name == "humanoidrootpart" or name == "root" or name == "hitbox" or name == "collision" then
        return false
    end
    if part.Transparency >= 0.99 then return false end
    return true
end

local function updateChams()
    if not Settings.ChamsEnabled then
        for player, partMap in pairs(partChamsCache) do
            for part, adornment in pairs(partMap) do
                if adornment and typeof(adornment) == "Instance" then adornment:Destroy() end
            end
        end
        partChamsCache = {}
        for player, highlight in pairs(highlightChamsCache) do
            if highlight and typeof(highlight) == "Instance" then highlight:Destroy() end
        end
        highlightChamsCache = {}
        return
    end

    for player, partMap in pairs(partChamsCache) do
        if not player or not player.Parent then
            for part, adornment in pairs(partMap) do
                if adornment then adornment:Destroy() end
            end
            partChamsCache[player] = nil
        end
    end
    for player, highlight in pairs(highlightChamsCache) do
        if not player or not player.Parent then
            if highlight then highlight:Destroy() end
            highlightChamsCache[player] = nil
        end
    end

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player == LocalPlayer then continue end
        local char = player.Character
        local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local isDead = char and (char:GetAttribute("Dead") == true or (humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0))
        local allowed = char and not isDead and (not Settings.TeamCheck or isOppositeTeam(LocalPlayer, player))

        if allowed then
            local chamColor = Settings.ChamsColor
            if Settings.UseTeamColorChams then
                local side = getNormalizedSide(player)
                if side == "T" then chamColor = Color3.fromRGB(240, 160, 40)
                elseif side == "CT" then chamColor = Color3.fromRGB(50, 140, 240) end
            end

            if Settings.ChamsMode == "Precision Body Chams" then
                if highlightChamsCache[player] then
                    highlightChamsCache[player]:Destroy()
                    highlightChamsCache[player] = nil
                end

                if not partChamsCache[player] then partChamsCache[player] = {} end
                local partMap = partChamsCache[player]

                for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                    if isVisibleBodyPart(child) then
                        local adornment = partMap[child]
                        if not adornment or not adornment.Parent or adornment.Parent ~= child then
                            if adornment then adornment:Destroy() end
                            adornment = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
                            adornment.Name = "Cham_" .. child.Name
                            adornment.AlwaysOnTop = true
                            adornment.ZIndex = 10
                            adornment.Parent = child
                            partMap[child] = adornment
                        end

                        adornment.Adornee = child
                        adornment.Size = child.Size
                        adornment.Color3 = chamColor
                        adornment.Transparency = Settings.ChamsFillTransparency or 0.3
                        adornment.Visible = true
                    end
                end

                for part, adornment in pairs(partMap) do
                    if not part or not part.Parent or part.Parent ~= char then
                        if adornment then adornment:Destroy() end
                        partMap[part] = nil
                    end
                end

            elseif Settings.ChamsMode == "Highlight Chams" then
                if partChamsCache[player] then
                    for part, adornment in pairs(partChamsCache[player]) do
                        if adornment then adornment:Destroy() end
                    end
                    partChamsCache[player] = nil
                end

                local highlight = highlightChamsCache[player]
                if not highlight or not highlight.Parent then
                    highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                    highlight.Name = "FatalityChams_" .. player.Name
                    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                    highlight.Parent = char
                    highlightChamsCache[player] = highlight
                end

                if highlight.Adornee ~= char then highlight.Adornee = char end
                highlight.Enabled = true
                highlight.FillColor = chamColor
                highlight.OutlineColor = chamColor
                highlight.FillTransparency = Settings.ChamsFillTransparency or 0.4
                highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
            end

        else
            if partChamsCache[player] then
                for part, adornment in pairs(partMap) do
                    if adornment then adornment:Destroy() end
                end
                partChamsCache[player] = nil
            end
            if highlightChamsCache[player] then
                highlightChamsCache[player]:Destroy()
                highlightChamsCache[player] = nil
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Поиск Ближайшего Противника (Противоположная Команда)
-- ==========================================
local function getClosestEnemyPart(): BasePart?
    local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return nil end
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return nil end

    local myPos = root.Position
    local closestDist = math.huge
    local closestPart = nil

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player == LocalPlayer then continue end
        local pChar = player.Character
        if not pChar then continue end

        local humanoid = pChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local isDead = pChar:GetAttribute("Dead") == true or (humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0)
        local isInvincible = pChar:GetAttribute("Invincible") == true
        if isDead or isInvincible then continue end
        if pChar.Parent and pChar.Parent.Name == "Debris" then continue end

        -- Атакуем ТОЛЬКО противоположную команду!
        if not isOppositeTeam(LocalPlayer, player) then continue end

        local ePart = pChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or pChar:FindFirstChild("Head") or pChar.PrimaryPart
        if ePart then
            local dist = (ePart.Position - myPos).Magnitude
            if dist < closestDist then
                closestDist = dist
                closestPart = ePart
            end
        end
    end

    return closestPart
end

local function FindSilentTarget()
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not Camera or not LocalPlayer.Character then 
        getgenv().ParsaSilentTarget = nil 
        return nil
    end
    
    local camPos = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local lookVec = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
    local screenCenter = Camera.ViewportSize / 2
    local closestDist = math.huge
    local closestPart = nil

    for _, player in next, Players:GetPlayers() do
        if player == LocalPlayer then continue end
        local char = player.Character
        if not char or char:GetAttribute("Dead") or char:GetAttribute("Invincible") then continue end
        if char.Parent and char.Parent.Name == "Debris" then continue end

        -- АТАКА ТОЛЬКО ПРОТИВОПОЛОЖНОЙ КОМАНДЫ
        if Settings.TeamCheck and not isOppositeTeam(LocalPlayer, player) then continue end

        local targetPart = char:FindFirstChild(Settings.HitPart) or char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char.PrimaryPart
        if not targetPart then continue end

        -- Векторная проверка угла (Vector3 & Unit Vector & Dot Product)
        local inVectorFOV, angleDeg = VectorMath.isInVectorFOV(camPos, lookVec, targetPart.Position, Settings.AutoFireAngleFOV)
        
        local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(targetPart.Position)
        if onScreen then
            local distFromCenter = (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - screenCenter).Magnitude
            local maxRadius = Settings.UseFOV and Settings.FOVRadius or math.huge
            
            if inVectorFOV and distFromCenter <= maxRadius and distFromCenter < closestDist then
                if Settings.Wallbang or isVisible(targetPart) then
                    closestDist = distFromCenter
                    closestPart = targetPart
                end
            end
        end
    end
    getgenv().ParsaSilentTarget = closestPart
    return closestPart
end

    local lowerTorso = char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")
    local rootPart = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    local neck = (head and head:FindFirstChild("Neck")) or (upperTorso and upperTorso:FindFirstChild("Neck"))
    local waist = (upperTorso and upperTorso:FindFirstChild("Waist")) or (lowerTorso and lowerTorso:FindFirstChild("Waist"))

local function updateAntiAimState()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end

    if char ~= lastCharAA then
        lastCharAA = char
        originalNeckC0 = nil
        originalWaistC0 = nil
        originalRootC0 = nil
    end

    local neck, waist, rootJoint, humanoid = getJoints()

    if neck and not originalNeckC0 then originalNeckC0 = neck.C0 end
    if waist and not originalWaistC0 then originalWaistC0 = waist.C0 end
    if rootJoint and not originalRootC0 then originalRootC0 = rootJoint.C0 end

    if not Settings.AntiAim then
        if neck and originalNeckC0 then neck.C0 = originalNeckC0 end
        if waist and originalWaistC0 then waist.C0 = originalWaistC0 end
        if rootJoint and originalRootC0 then rootJoint.C0 = originalRootC0 end
        if humanoid then humanoid.AutoRotate = true end
        return
    end

    if humanoid then humanoid.AutoRotate = false end

    -- Если включена пауза при стрельбе и идет выстрел, выпрямляем персонажа
    if Settings.AntiAimDisableOnFire and Settings.IsFiringState then
        if neck and originalNeckC0 then neck.C0 = originalNeckC0 end
        if waist and originalWaistC0 then waist.C0 = originalWaistC0 end
        if rootJoint and originalRootC0 then rootJoint.C0 = originalRootC0 end
        return
    end

    -- Находим противника из противоположной команды
    local enemyPart = getgenv().ParsaSilentTarget or getClosestEnemyPart()
    local rootPart = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    -- Динамически разворачиваем персонажа СПИНОЙ ИМЕННО К ПОЗИЦИИ ВРАГА!
    if rootPart then
        local myPos = rootPart.Position
        local enemyPos = enemyPart and enemyPart.Position

        if enemyPos then
            local delta = Vector3.new(enemyPos.X - myPos.X, 0, enemyPos.Z - myPos.Z)
            if delta.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                -- Лицом от врага -> СПИНА НАПРАВЛЕНА ПРЯМО НА ВРАГА
                rootPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(myPos, myPos - delta.Unit)
            end
        elseif Camera then
            local lookDir = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
            local flatLook = Vector3.new(lookDir.X, 0, lookDir.Z)
            if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                rootPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(myPos, myPos - flatLook.Unit)
            end
        end
    end

    -- Расчет Pitch
    local pitchRad = 0
    local pitchMode = Settings.AntiAimPitchMode or "Down"
    if pitchMode == "Down" then
        pitchRad = math.rad(-89)
    elseif pitchMode == "Up" then
        pitchRad = math.rad(89)
    elseif pitchMode == "Jitter" then
        pitchRad = math.rad(math.random() > 0.5 and -89 or 89)
    elseif pitchMode == "Custom" then
        pitchRad = math.rad(Settings.AntiAimAngle or -89)
    end

    -- Расчет Yaw
    local yawRad = 0
    local yawMode = Settings.AntiAimYawMode or "AtTargets"
    if yawMode == "Spinbot" then
        spinAngle = (spinAngle + (Settings.AntiAimSpinSpeed or 15)) % 360
        yawRad = math.rad(spinAngle)
    elseif yawMode == "Jitter" then
        yawRad = math.rad(math.random() > 0.5 and 90 or -90)
    elseif yawMode == "Sideways" then
        yawRad = math.rad(90)
    elseif yawMode == "Backwards" then
        yawRad = math.pi
    end

    -- Применяем CFrame к суставам
    if neck and originalNeckC0 then
        neck.C0 = originalNeckC0 * CFrame.Angles(pitchRad, yawRad, 0)
    end

    if waist and originalWaistC0 then
        waist.C0 = originalWaistC0 * CFrame.Angles(pitchRad * 0.4, 0, 0)
    end

    if rootJoint and originalRootC0 and yawMode == "Spinbot" then
        rootJoint.C0 = originalRootC0 * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, yawRad)
    elseif rootJoint and originalRootC0 then
        rootJoint.C0 = originalRootC0
    end
end

local function updateThirdPersonState()
    if not LocalPlayer then return end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

    if Settings.ThirdPerson then
        local dist = Settings.ThirdPersonDist or 12
        LocalPlayer.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
        LocalPlayer.CameraMinZoomDistance = dist
        LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = dist

        if char and Camera then
            local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if head then
                for _, descendant in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                    if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                        descendant.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                    end
                end

                if Settings.HideViewModelInThirdPerson then
                    setViewModelVisibility(false)
                end

                local focusPos = head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
                local lookDir = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
                local targetCamPos = focusPos - (lookDir * dist)

                local tpRayParams = RaycastParams.new()
                tpRayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                tpRayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }

                local hitResult = Workspace:Raycast(focusPos, -lookDir * dist, tpRayParams)
                if hitResult then
                    targetCamPos = hitResult.Position + (lookDir * 0.5)
                end

                Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetCamPos, focusPos)
            end
        end
        lastThirdPersonState = true
    else
        if lastThirdPersonState then
            LocalPlayer.CameraMinZoomDistance = originalMinZoom
            LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = originalMaxZoom
            setViewModelVisibility(true)
            lastThirdPersonState = false
        end
    end
end

task.spawn(function()
    if typeof(hookfunction) ~= "function" or typeof(getgc) ~= "function" then
        return
    end

    local bulletClass = nil
    for attempt = 1, 45 do
        for _, obj in next, getgc(true) do
            if type(obj) == "table" and typeof(rawget(obj, "_performRaycast")) == "function" and rawget(obj, "getTrueSpread") ~= nil then
                bulletClass = obj
                break
            end
        end
        if bulletClass then break end
        task.wait(0.5)
    end

    if bulletClass then
        local oldRaycast
        oldRaycast = hookfunction(bulletClass._performRaycast, function(...)
            local returns = table.pack(oldRaycast(...))
            local result = returns[1]
            local SilentTarget = getgenv().ParsaSilentTarget

            if type(result) == "table" then
                pcall(function()
                    local origin = rawget(result, "Origin") or (Workspace.CurrentCamera and Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position)
                    local targetPos = nil

                    if Settings.SilentEnabled and SilentTarget and SilentTarget.Parent then
                        targetPos = SilentTarget.Position
                    else
                        local hits = rawget(result, "Hits")
                        if type(hits) == "table" and #hits > 0 and hits[#hits] and hits[#hits].Position then
                            targetPos = hits[#hits].Position
                        elseif rawget(result, "Direction") and origin then
                            targetPos = origin + (result.Direction * (result.Distance or 500))
                        end
                    end

                    if origin and targetPos then
                        spawnBulletTracer(origin, targetPos)
                        spawnHitExplosion(targetPos)
                    end

                    if Settings.SilentEnabled and SilentTarget and SilentTarget.Parent then
                        local hits = rawget(result, "Hits")
                        if type(hits) ~= "table" then return end

                        local aimPos = SilentTarget.Position
                        local lastIndex = nil
                        
                        for index, hit in pairs(hits) do
                            if type(hit) == "table" then
                                if lastIndex == nil or index > lastIndex then lastIndex = index end
                            end
                        end

                        local finalHit = lastIndex and hits[lastIndex]
                        if type(finalHit) ~= "table" then return end

                        finalHit.Instance = SilentTarget
                        finalHit.Position = aimPos
                        if finalHit.Exit ~= nil then finalHit.Exit = false end

                        if typeof(origin) == "Vector3" then
                            local delta = aimPos - origin
                            local length = delta.Magnitude
                            if length > 0.001 then
                                result.Distance = length
                                result.Direction = delta.Unit
                                
                                local unit = delta.Unit
                                for index, hit in pairs(hits) do
                                    if index ~= lastIndex and type(hit) == "table" and typeof(hit.Position) == "Vector3" then
                                        local along = (hit.Position - origin):Dot(unit)
                                        if along > length then
                                            hit.Position = origin + unit * (length * 0.5)
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            return table.unpack(returns, 1, returns.n)
        end)
    end
end)

-- CORE LOGIC FOR SYSTEM FILTERING AND STATE MANAGEMENT --

-- Ancestor-name keywords that mark a button as off-limits (purchases, morphs, teams, spawns)
local BLOCKED_KEYWORDS = {
	"gamepass", "game pass", "robux", "donate", "buy", "purchase", "product",
	"vip", "shop", "team", "morph", "skin", "outfit", "costume", "cosmetic", "spawn",
	"cloth", "shirt", "pants", "trouser", "uniform", "dress", "wardrobe", "accessor", "avatar",
}

-- Filter out purchasing interfaces, dev products, gamepasses, morphs, and team selectors
local function isSafeGameplayButton(detector)
	local parent = detector.Parent
	if not parent then return false end
	
	local current = detector
	while current and current ~= workspace do
		local nameLower = string.lower(current.Name)
		for _, word in ipairs(BLOCKED_KEYWORDS) do
			if string.find(nameLower, word, 1, true) then
				return false
			end
		end
		current = current.Parent
	end
	return true
end

-- A "door" is any model named Door/Gate, inside a Gates folder, or containing a Door1 part
-- (this also catches things like Lift > BottomGate). The Lift model itself is NOT a door.
local function isDoorModel(model)
	if not model:IsA("Model") then return false end
	if model.Name == "Lift" then return false end
	if model.Name == "Gate" or model.Name == "Door" then return true end
	if model.Parent and string.lower(model.Parent.Name) == "gates" then return true end
	local d1 = model:FindFirstChild("Door1")
	if d1 and d1:IsA("BasePart") then return true end
	return false
end

-- True for the TopGate / BottomGate models that belong to a lift
local function isLiftGate(model)
	return model.Parent ~= nil and model.Parent.Name == "Lift"
		and (model.Name == "TopGate" or model.Name == "BottomGate")
end

-- Picks the part used to track whether a door has moved.
-- Returns the part and whether it's a real door panel (Door1/Door) vs a chamber's Main part.
local function getReferencePart(model)
	local p = model:FindFirstChild("Door1") or model:FindFirstChild("Door")
	if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then return p, true end
	
	p = model:FindFirstChild("Main")
	if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then return p, false end
	
	if model.PrimaryPart then return model.PrimaryPart, false end
	return nil, false
end

-- Baseline positions (assumed CLOSED at launch) for doors that only have a single moving part
local function cacheOriginalPositions()
	for _, model in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if isDoorModel(model) then
			local ref = getReferencePart(model)
			if ref and not originalPositions[ref] then
				originalPositions[ref] = ref.Position
			end
		end
	end
end
cacheOriginalPositions()

-- Returns true if the door is open. Also returns the measured gap/movement (for debugging).
local function isGateOpen(model)
	local ref, isPanel = getReferencePart(model)
	if not ref then return false, 0 end
	
	-- Instant-delete style doors (only meaningful on real door panels)
	if isPanel and (ref.Transparency > 0.5 or ref.CanCollide == false) then
		return true, 0
	end
	
	-- Two-panel doors: Door1 and Door2 touch when closed and slide apart when open
	local door2 = model:FindFirstChild("Door2")
	if isPanel and door2 and door2:IsA("BasePart") then
		local rel = ref.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(door2.Position - ref.Position)
		local comps = {rel.X, rel.Y, rel.Z}
		local sizes1 = {ref.Size.X, ref.Size.Y, ref.Size.Z}
		local sizes2 = {door2.Size.X, door2.Size.Y, door2.Size.Z}
		
		-- The slide axis is whichever axis the panels are offset along the most
		local axis = 1
		for i = 2, 3 do
			if math.abs(comps[i]) > math.abs(comps[axis]) then axis = i end
		end
		
		local gap = math.abs(comps[axis])
		local closedGap = (sizes1[axis] + sizes2[axis]) / 2
		return gap > closedGap + CLOSED_TOLERANCE, gap - closedGap
	end
	
	-- Single-part doors and chamber gates: open = moved away from the saved position
	local initialPos = originalPositions[ref]
	if initialPos then
		local moved = (ref.Position - initialPos).Magnitude
		local open = moved > 1.5
		
		if not isPanel then
			-- Grey box (106) gate has plain "Wall" children; the 096 gate does not
			if model:FindFirstChild("Wall") then
				if INVERT_106 then open = not open end
			else
				if INVERT_096 then open = not open end
			end
		end
		
		return open, moved
	end
	return false, 0
end

-- Finds ONE safe ClickDetector for a door. Doors with two button hitboxes
-- (one per side) toggle twice if both are fired, which cancels the action out.
local function findDoorClickDetector(model)
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("ClickDetector") and isSafeGameplayButton(d) then
			return d
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- action: "close" or "open"
-- cooldown (optional): seconds to skip a door after it was last clicked.
-- skipLifts (optional): leave lift gates alone (used by auto-lock).
local function executeSynchronizedAction(action, cooldown, skipLifts)
	cacheOriginalPositions()

	for _, model in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if isDoorModel(model) and not (skipLifts and isLiftGate(model)) then
			
			local onCooldown = cooldown and lastFired[model] and (os.clock() - lastFired[model]) < cooldown
			
			if not onCooldown then
				local isOpen = isGateOpen(model)
				
				-- Close = click doors that are open. Open = click doors that are closed.
				local shouldFire = (action == "close" and isOpen) or (action == "open" and not isOpen)
				
				if shouldFire then
					local cd = findDoorClickDetector(model)
					if cd then
						fireclickdetector(cd) -- only ONE click per door
						lastFired[model] = os.clock()
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Each detector has independent timing, including detectors added later.
local function startSpamWorker(cd)
	if not running or not spamActive or not cd:IsA("ClickDetector")
		or not cd:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or not isSafeGameplayButton(cd) or spamWorkers[cd] then
		return
	end
	local generation = spamGeneration
	local worker = {}
	spamWorkers[cd] = worker
	task.spawn(function()
		while running and spamActive and spamGeneration == generation
			and spamWorkers[cd] == worker and cd:IsDescendantOf(workspace) do
			-- Stagger the first click as well as every subsequent click.
			task.wait(spamRandom:NextNumber(SPAM_MIN_INTERVAL, SPAM_MAX_INTERVAL))
			if not running or not spamActive or spamGeneration ~= generation
				or spamWorkers[cd] ~= worker or not cd:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
				break
			end
			-- Recheck in case the detector was renamed or moved into an excluded group.
			if isSafeGameplayButton(cd) then
				pcall(function() fireclickdetector(cd) end)
			end
		end
		if spamWorkers[cd] == worker then
			spamWorkers[cd] = nil
		end
	end)
end

track(workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(startSpamWorker))
track(workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(instance)
	spamWorkers[instance] = nil
end))


-- LIFT LOGIC (keeps lifts parked on the top floor during auto-lock) --

local liftCache = {}
local liftCacheTime = -math.huge
local liftState = {} -- [lift] = {lastPos, lastCall}

local function getLifts()
	if os.clock() - liftCacheTime > 10 then
		liftCache = {}
		for _, m in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if m:IsA("Model") and m.Name == "Lift"
				and m:FindFirstChild("Platform") and m:FindFirstChild("TopGate") and m:FindFirstChild("BottomGate") then
				table.insert(liftCache, m)
			end
		end
		liftCacheTime = os.clock()
	end
	return liftCache
end

-- Static reference point for a lift gate (its DoorHitbox if it has one)
local function liftGatePos(gate)
	local hb = gate:FindFirstChild("DoorHitbox")
	if hb and hb:IsA("BasePart") then return hb.Position end
	return gate:GetPivot().Position
end

-- True if the platform is closer to the top gate than the bottom gate
local function isLiftAtTop(lift)
	local pos = lift.Platform:GetPivot().Position
	local topDist = (pos - liftGatePos(lift.TopGate)).Magnitude
	local bottomDist = (pos - liftGatePos(lift.BottomGate)).Magnitude
	return topDist <= bottomDist
end

-- If a lift has stopped at the bottom, call it up using its TopGate button
local function keepLiftsOnTop()
	for _, lift in ipairs(getLifts()) do
		if lift.Parent and lift:FindFirstChild("Platform") then
			local st = liftState[lift]
			if not st then
				st = {lastPos = nil, lastCall = -math.huge}
				liftState[lift] = st
			end
			
			local pos = lift.Platform:GetPivot().Position
			local stationary = st.lastPos ~= nil and (pos - st.lastPos).Magnitude < 0.05
			st.lastPos = pos
			
			if stationary and not isLiftAtTop(lift) and (os.clock() - st.lastCall) >= LIFT_COOLDOWN then
				local cd = findDoorClickDetector(lift.TopGate)
				if cd then
					fireclickdetector(cd)
					st.lastCall = os.clock()
				end
			end
		end
	end
end


-- SPRINKLER LOGIC --

local sprinklerLeverCD = nil -- Cached lever ClickDetector
local sprinklerEmitters = {} -- Cached sprinkler particle emitters
local sprinklerSounds = {} -- Cached sprinkler audio
local lastSprinklerClick = -math.huge
local lastSprinklerSearch = -math.huge
local warnedNoParts = false
local warnedUnverified = false
local sprinklersSeenOn = false -- True once we've watched them be ON during this auto session
local sprinklerPausedAt = nil -- Time someone else turned them off (auto stays hands-off)
local sprinklerUnverified = 0 -- Clicks we made that we haven't yet seen turn the sprinklers ON
local sprinklerBlindClicked = false -- Fallback: one click made when the state can't be read

-- Finds the lever ClickDetector, sprinkler emitters and sprinkler audio
local function findSprinklerParts()
	lastSprinklerSearch = os.clock()
	sprinklerLeverCD = nil
	sprinklerEmitters = {}
	sprinklerSounds = {}
	
	for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("ClickDetector") and not sprinklerLeverCD
			and d:FindFirstAncestor("Sprinkler System Controls") and isSafeGameplayButton(d) then
			sprinklerLeverCD = d
		elseif d:FindFirstAncestor("Sprinkler System") then
			if d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
				table.insert(sprinklerEmitters, d)
			elseif d:IsA("Sound") then
				table.insert(sprinklerSounds, d)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Sprinklers count as ON if an emitter is actively emitting OR the sprinkler audio is playing
local function areSprinklersOn()
	for _, e in ipairs(sprinklerEmitters) do
		if e.Parent and e.Enabled and e.Rate > 0 then
			return true
		end
	end
	for _, s in ipairs(sprinklerSounds) do
		if s.Parent and s.IsPlaying then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function runAutoSprinklers()
	-- Re-find parts if we don't have them (searched at most every 5 seconds)
	if (not sprinklerLeverCD or not sprinklerLeverCD.Parent or (#sprinklerEmitters + #sprinklerSounds) == 0)
		and (os.clock() - lastSprinklerSearch) > 5 then
		findSprinklerParts()
	end
	
	if not sprinklerLeverCD then
		if not warnedNoParts then
			warnedNoParts = true
			warn("[Auto Sprinklers] Couldn't find the sprinkler lever. Not clicking.")
		end
		return
	end
	
	-- Fallback: the state can't be read, so click the lever ONCE and then stay hands-off
	if (#sprinklerEmitters + #sprinklerSounds) == 0 then
		if not sprinklerBlindClicked then
			sprinklerBlindClicked = true
			fireclickdetector(sprinklerLeverCD)
			warn("[Auto Sprinklers] Can't read the sprinkler state, so the lever was clicked once. Make sure they were OFF when you enabled this.")
		end
		return
	end
	
	if areSprinklersOn() then
		sprinklersSeenOn = true
		sprinklerPausedAt = nil
		sprinklerUnverified = 0
		return
	end
	
	-- Sprinklers are OFF. If we'd seen them ON, someone turned them off, so leave them off.
	if sprinklersSeenOn and not sprinklerPausedAt then
		sprinklerPausedAt = os.clock()
		sprinklersSeenOn = false
	end
	
	if sprinklerPausedAt then
		if (os.clock() - sprinklerPausedAt) < SPRINKLER_RESUME_AFTER then
			return -- stay off
		end
		sprinklerPausedAt = nil -- resume delay passed
	end
	
	-- We already clicked once and never saw them turn ON: stop instead of flipping them back off
	if sprinklerUnverified >= 1 then
		if not warnedUnverified then
			warnedUnverified = true
			warn("[Auto Sprinklers] Clicked the lever but the sprinklers never read as ON. Press 'Print & Copy Door States' and check the SPRINKLERS section.")
		end
		return
	end

-- Builds the report, prints it to F9, and copies it to the clipboard.

local function printDoorStates()
	local lines = {"---------- DOOR STATES ----------"}
	local count = 0
	for _, model in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if isDoorModel(model) then
			count += 1
			local isOpen, measure = isGateOpen(model)
			local ref = getReferencePart(model)
			table.insert(lines, string.format("%s | %s | ref: %s | open-gap: %.2f",
				model:GetFullName(), isOpen and "OPEN" or "CLOSED", ref and ref.Name or "NONE", measure or 0))
		end
	end
	table.insert(lines, "Total doors found: " .. count)
	
	table.insert(lines, "---------- LIFTS ----------")
	for _, lift in ipairs(getLifts()) do
		if lift.Parent then
			table.insert(lines, string.format("%s | platform at %s", lift:GetFullName(), isLiftAtTop(lift) and "TOP" or "BOTTOM"))
		end
	end
	
	findSprinklerParts()
	table.insert(lines, "---------- SPRINKLERS ----------")
	table.insert(lines, "Lever ClickDetector: " .. (sprinklerLeverCD and sprinklerLeverCD:GetFullName() or "NOT FOUND"))
	for i, e in ipairs(sprinklerEmitters) do
		table.insert(lines, string.format("Emitter %d: Enabled=%s Rate=%s", i, tostring(e.Enabled), tostring(e.Rate)))
	end
	for i, s in ipairs(sprinklerSounds) do
		table.insert(lines, string.format("Sound %d: IsPlaying=%s Looped=%s", i, tostring(s.IsPlaying), tostring(s.Looped)))
	end
	-- List anything sprinkler-related with its class so we can see what the objects really are
	for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:FindFirstAncestor("Sprinkler System")
			and (d.Name == "Sprinkler" or d.Name == "Emitter" or d.Name == "SprinklerAudio" or d.Name == "Sound") then
			table.insert(lines, string.format("Found: %s [%s]", d:GetFullName(), d.ClassName))
		end
	end
	table.insert(lines, "Script reads sprinklers as: " .. (areSprinklersOn() and "ON" or "OFF"))
	
	local report = table.concat(lines, "\n")
	print(report)
	
	local copyFn = setclipboard or toclipboard
	if copyFn then
		local ok = pcall(copyFn, report)
		return ok
	end
	return false
end

This Script can...

- Force Close All Doors: Attempts to close every detected door and gate using its current position or state.

- Force Open All Doors: Attempts to open every detected door and gate.

- Auto-Lock Loop: Repeatedly closes doors that open and calls stopped lifts back to the top floor.

- Auto Sprinklers: Turns sprinklers on once. If someone turns them off afterward, it leaves them off until you restart the toggle.

- 096 / 106 Gate Inversion: Reverses how the script interprets each chamber gate’s open/closed state if its controls behave backward. So if the script keeps repeately opening the 096v or 106 chambers just click this button on the chamber tahts acting up to change teh driection of where this closes. Thsi happens because the script reads it as "I dont know whats close or open so I will use the location of where its at now as close" so if its open in a public server already, the script will read the chamber as close even if its open. Thats why theres an inversion button for the script.

- Spam Gameplay Buttons: Clicks eligible controls independently, choosing a new random 0.25–4 second interval before each click. Includes doors, gates, lift controls, and newly added ClickDetectors.
                 - Spam Exclusions: Skips controls identified as morphs, gamepasses,      purchases, clothing, cosmetics, team selectors, or spawns. Identification uses etector and ancestor names, so unusually named controls may need extra exclusions.

- Print & Copy Door States: Prints a diagnostic report to the F9 console and attempts to copy it to your clipboard. Includes door states, lift positions, and sprinkler details. (THIS IS MAINLY FOR WHEN I WAS CREATING THE SCRIPT. ALTHOUGH YOU CAN USE IT TO IMPROVE THE SCRIPT FOR YOUR OWN)

Panel controls
- Drag the title bar: Moves the panel.
- Drag the bottom-right corner: Resizes the panel.
- Minimize (−): Collapses the panel while active features keep running.
- X or P: Closes the GUI and stops all loops and pending tasks started by this script.
- Automatic cleanup: Also stops the script’s tasks if the GUI is removed, destroyed, hidden, or disabled. Running a new copy shuts down the previous copy first. (might be broken)
Door detection depends on the map’s structure. Single-part doors and chamber gates are assumed to be closed when the script first runs.

scripts.script:
-- BACKROOMS INFINITE MAZE LOADER SCRIPT (V4 - REAL FALL GRAVITY)
-- Sistem pembersihan ultra pantas, pemadaman Baseplate, dan jatuhan graviti rawak supaya pemain tidak bertindih di atas kepala.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

-- KONFIGURASI BACKROOMS
local CHUNK_SIZE = 40 
local WALL_HEIGHT = 12
local WALL_THICKNESS = 1
local RENDER_DISTANCE = 3 

local generatedChunks = {} 
local backroomsFolder

-- 1. PEMBERSIHAN MAP LAMA & BASEPLATE
local function clearMap()
    debug.profilebegin("FastMapClear")
    local children = workspace:GetChildren()
    for i = 1, #children do
        local obj = children[i]
        if not obj:IsA("Camera") and not obj:IsA("Terrain") then
            if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(obj) then
                obj:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end
    debug.profileend()
    print("✓ Map lama dan Baseplate dipadamkan!")
end

-- Fungsi Matematik Deterministik Maze
local function getDeterministicWall(chunkX, chunkZ, wallType)
    local seed = math.sin(chunkX * 12.9898 + chunkZ * 78.233) * 43758.5453
    local pseudoRandom = seed - math.floor(seed)
    if wallType == "North" then return pseudoRandom > 0.45 end
    if wallType == "West" then return pseudoRandom > 0.45 end
    if wallType == "CenterH" then return pseudoRandom > 0.55 end
    if wallType == "CenterV" then return pseudoRandom > 0.55 end
    return false
end

-- 2. PENJANAAN CHUNK
local function generateChunk(chunkX, chunkZ)
    local chunkKey = chunkX .. "," .. chunkZ
    if generatedChunks[chunkKey] then return end 
    generatedChunks[chunkKey] = true

    local chunkModel = Instance.new("Model")
    chunkModel.Name = "Chunk_" .. chunkKey
    chunkModel.Parent = backroomsFolder

    local worldX = chunkX * CHUNK_SIZE
    local worldZ = chunkZ * CHUNK_SIZE

    -- Lantai Karpet Kuning Lembap
    local floor = Instance.new("Part")
    floor.Size = Vector3.new(CHUNK_SIZE, 1, CHUNK_SIZE)
    floor.Position = Vector3.new(worldX, -0.5, worldZ)
    floor.Color = Color3.fromRGB(185, 170, 115) 
    floor.Material = Enum.Material.Fabric
    floor.Anchored = true
    floor.Parent = chunkModel

    -- Siling Beton
    local ceiling = Instance.new("Part")
    ceiling.Size = Vector3.new(CHUNK_SIZE, 1, CHUNK_SIZE)
    ceiling.Position = Vector3.new(worldX, WALL_HEIGHT + 0.5, worldZ)
    ceiling.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 195, 180)
    ceiling.Material = Enum.Material.Concrete
    ceiling.Anchored = true
    ceiling.Parent = chunkModel

    -- Fungsi Dinding
    local function createWall(size, position)
        local wall = Instance.new("Part")
        wall.Size = size
        wall.Position = position
        wall.Color = Color3.fromRGB(215, 200, 130) 
        wall.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        wall.Anchored = true
        wall.Parent = chunkModel
    end

    if getDeterministicWall(chunkX, chunkZ, "North") then
        createWall(Vector3.new(CHUNK_SIZE, WALL_HEIGHT, WALL_THICKNESS), Vector3.new(worldX, WALL_HEIGHT/2, worldZ - CHUNK_SIZE/2))
    end
    if getDeterministicWall(chunkX, chunkZ, "West") then
        createWall(Vector3.new(WALL_THICKNESS, WALL_HEIGHT, CHUNK_SIZE), Vector3.new(worldX - CHUNK_SIZE/2, WALL_HEIGHT/2, worldZ))
    end
    if getDeterministicWall(chunkX, chunkZ, "CenterH") then
        createWall(Vector3.new(CHUNK_SIZE/2, WALL_HEIGHT, WALL_THICKNESS), Vector3.new(worldX - CHUNK_SIZE/4, WALL_HEIGHT/2, worldZ))
    end
    if getDeterministicWall(chunkX, chunkZ, "CenterV") then
        createWall(Vector3.new(WALL_THICKNESS, WALL_HEIGHT, CHUNK_SIZE/2), Vector3.new(worldX, WALL_HEIGHT/2, worldZ + CHUNK_SIZE/4))
    end

    -- Lampu Neon
    local lightPart = Instance.new("Part")
    lightPart.Size = Vector3.new(4, 0.2, 2)
    lightPart.Position = Vector3.new(worldX, WALL_HEIGHT - 0.1, worldZ)
    lightPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 230)
    lightPart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    lightPart.Anchored = true
    lightPart.Parent = chunkModel

    local pointLight = Instance.new("PointLight")
    pointLight.Brightness = 2
    pointLight.Range = 30
    pointLight.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 200)
    pointLight.Parent = lightPart

    if math.random() > 0.7 then
        task.spawn(function()
            while task.wait(math.random(3, 10)) do
                if not lightPart or not lightPart.Parent then break end
                pointLight.Enabled = false
                lightPart.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                task.wait(math.random(0.1, 0.4))
                pointLight.Enabled = true
                lightPart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            end
        end)
    end
end

-- 3. LOAD MAP BACKROOM UTAMA
local function createBackroomsMap()
    backroomsFolder = Instance.new("Model")
    backroomsFolder.Name = "Backrooms_Infinite"
    backroomsFolder.Parent = workspace
    
    local spawnPart = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
    spawnPart.Name = "MainSpawn"
    spawnPart.Size = Vector3.new(15, 1, 15)
    spawnPart.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
    spawnPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 140, 100)
    spawnPart.Material = Enum.Material.Fabric
    spawnPart.Anchored = true
    spawnPart.CanCollide = true
    spawnPart.Parent = backroomsFolder

    for x = -2, 2 do
        for z = -2, 2 do
            generateChunk(x, z)
        end
    end
    
    Lighting.Brightness = 0.8
    Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(80, 75, 60)
    Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
    Lighting.ClockTime = 12
    Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
    
    local ambientSound = Instance.new("Sound")
    ambientSound.Name = "FluorescentHum"
    ambientSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://9069509268" 
    ambientSound.Volume = 0.4
    ambientSound.Looped = true
    ambientSound.Parent = workspace
    ambientSound:Play()
    
    print("✓ Backrooms Map Yuklendi!")
end

-- 4. TELEPORTASI DAN JATUH DENGAN GRAVITI REALISTIK (Anti-Bertindih)
local function teleportPlayerWithGravity(character)
    local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
    
    if rootPart and humanoid then
        -- MENGALIS RENTIK: Membuat kedudukan X dan Z rawak (jejari 4 stud) di kawasan spawn
        -- Ketinggian (Y = 10.5) ditetapkan ngam di bawah siling supaya mereka jatuh bebas secara realistik
        local offsetX = math.random(-4, 4)
        local offsetZ = math.random(-4, 4)
        local targetPosition = Vector3.new(offsetX, 10.5, offsetZ)
        
        -- Pindahkan watak dengan PivotTo ke udara
        character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(targetPosition))
        
        -- Memaksa fizik Roblox mengemas kini jatuhan momentum dengan serta-merta
        task.defer(function()
            if rootPart then
                rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, -25, 0) -- Momentum awal jatuhan laju ke bawah karpet
            end
        end)
    end
end

-- Teleport untuk semua pemain sedia ada
local function respawnPlayers()
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            teleportPlayerWithGravity(player.Character)
        end
    end
end

-- 5. RESPON KEMATIAN DENGAN GRAVITI RAWAK
local function setupDeathRespawn()
    local function onCharacterAdded(character)
        task.wait(0.1) -- Tunggu watak dimuatkan sepenuhnya oleh enjin game
        teleportPlayerWithGravity(character)
    end

    local function onPlayerAdded(player)
        player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)
    end

    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
    
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)
    end
end

-- 6. SISTEM AUTO-GENERATE PANTAS (Semasa Berjalan)
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.5) do 
        local playersList = Players:GetPlayers()
        for i = 1, #playersList do
            local player = playersList[i]
            if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                local hrp = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                local currentChunkX = math.floor((hrp.Position.X + CHUNK_SIZE/2) / CHUNK_SIZE)
                local currentChunkZ = math.floor((hrp.Position.Z + CHUNK_SIZE/2) / CHUNK_SIZE)

                for x = -RENDER_DISTANCE, RENDER_DISTANCE do
                    for z = -RENDER_DISTANCE, RENDER_DISTANCE do
                        generateChunk(currentChunkX + x, currentChunkZ + z)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- EKSEKUSI UTAMA
print("==========================================")
-- Memulakan sistem muat turun Backrooms
print("==========================================")

clearMap()            
createBackroomsMap()  
respawnPlayers()      
setupDeathRespawn()   

print("==========================================")
print("SISTEM REAL GRAVITY JATUH AKTIF!")
print("==========================================")
